name: Women In Church
overview: Scripture presents the role of women within the church and family as one marked by order and godly conduct. From the consequences of the Fall, women are called to a position of submission to their husbands, reflecting the created order established at creation and affirmed in Ephesians 5:22. Additionally, older women are instructed to exemplify holiness and teach what is good, serving as spiritual mentors within the church community, as seen in Titus 2:3. These passages emphasize a Christ-centered structure of relationships grounded in submission, holiness, and teaching.
